meta.title: 一个视频教会你 AI 数字人
meta.title_en: AI Digital Humans in One Video

scenes.title_en: The Entry and Two Avatar Options
scenes.context: 打开剪映点开始创作，左侧上方工具栏找到数字人工具。形象有两种方案：定制形象上传正面照自动生成，或用内置形象（热门/超仿真/绿幕主题）。
sentences: 今天我就用剪映，一步步带你做一个既实用又有个性的数字人。
Today I'll use JianYing to walk you through making a digital human that's both practical and personal.
walk you through（一步步带你）
点击定制形象功能，上传一张清晰的正面照片，系统会自动生成属于你的AI数字人。
Tap the custom-avatar feature, upload a clear front-facing photo, and the system auto-generates your own AI digital human.
a front-facing photo（正面照片）
推荐大家使用绿幕主题，这些形象的背景是透明的，只保留人物本身。
I recommend the green-screen theme — the backgrounds are transparent, keeping only the person.
the green-screen theme（绿幕主题）
paraphrase: If you'd rather stay anonymous on camera.
scenes.speak: Today I'll use JianYing to walk you through making a digital human that's both practical and personal. Tap the custom-avatar feature, upload a clear front-facing photo, and the system auto-generates your own AI digital human. I recommend the green-screen theme — the backgrounds are transparent, keeping only the person.

scenes.context: 选好形象后在右侧切换景别/背景，先保持空背景方便后续换素材。下一步处理文案：粘贴现成文案，或点智能文案图标输入需求自动生成。
sentences: 在右侧将功能滑到底部，切换不同的景别，同时还可以切换数字人的背景。
Scroll the right panel to the bottom to switch scenes, and you can also swap the digital human's background.
swap the background（切换背景）
这里我们暂时保持空背景，方便后续切换成素材的背景来使用。
We'll keep an empty background for now, so we can swap in a footage background later.
an empty background（空背景）
如果没有文案，点击这个蓝色的智能文案小图标，输入你的需求。
No script? Tap the blue smart-copy icon and type what you need.
the smart-copy icon（智能文案图标）
系统会自动生成几组文案供你选择，如果不满意可以点击下一个。
The system generates a few script drafts to choose from — hit next if you don't like them.
script drafts（文案草稿）
paraphrase: Give the video its own look.
scenes.speak: Scroll the right panel to the bottom to switch scenes, and you can also swap the digital human's background. We'll keep an empty background for now, so we can swap in a footage background later. No script? Tap the blue smart-copy icon and type what you need. The system generates a few script drafts to choose from — hit next if you don't like them.

scenes.context: 选声音：克隆音色点加号生成，或点右侧小三角选主题声音，超仿真更真实。勾选同时生成字幕→点击生成→自动合成语音与动作、口型同步。
sentences: 如果你有自己想要中意的声音，你可以通过左边这个克隆音色，点击加号生成克隆的音色。
If you want a specific voice, use the voice-clone option on the left and tap the plus to generate it.
voice clone（克隆音色）
如果想要音色更真实的，可以选择超仿真主题，试听不同声音，挑选一个你想要的。
For a more realistic voice, pick the hyper-real theme, audition the options, and choose one.
audition the options（试听）
勾选下方的同时生成字幕，然后点击生成，系统会自动合成语音和数字人动作，人物形象和口型都会同步匹配。
Check 'generate subtitles too', hit generate, and the system merges voice and motion — the avatar and lip movement match perfectly.
lip movement（口型）
scenes.speak: If you want a specific voice, use the voice-clone option on the left and tap the plus to generate it. For a more realistic voice, pick the hyper-real theme, audition the options, and choose one. Check 'generate subtitles too', hit generate, and the system merges voice and motion — the avatar and lip movement match perfectly.

scenes.context: 官方素材库搜索风景素材拖到数字人下方，长视频拖多段。片尾多余用Ctrl+B分割删除；带原声的右键分离后一键删除。
sentences: 点击官方素材库，这里我们可以搜索一个风景素材，然后把自己喜欢的背景拖到时间线的数字人下方。
Open the official library, search a scenery clip, and drag your favorite background beneath the digital human on the timeline.
drag it beneath（拖到下方）
如果你的数字人视频比较长，可以多拖几段不同的风景素材，这样能让画面更具有多样性。
For a longer video, drag in several different scenery clips so the visuals stay varied.
more variety（更多多样性）
可以选中它用快捷键Ctrl+B分割，然后删除掉。
Select it, split it with the Ctrl+B shortcut, then delete.
the Ctrl+B shortcut（Ctrl+B快捷键）
我们可以通过鼠标右键将它们一个一个的分离出来，然后选中所有分离出来的音频，一键删除所有原声。
Right-click to detach the audio one by one, select all the detached clips, and delete every original sound in one tap.
detach the audio（分离音频）
paraphrase: Clear it all with one click.
A backdrop with its own flavor.
scenes.speak: Open the official library, search a scenery clip, and drag your favorite background beneath the digital human on the timeline. For a longer video, drag in several different scenery clips so the visuals stay varied. Select it, split it with the Ctrl+B shortcut, then delete. Right-click to detach the audio one by one, select all the detached clips, and delete every original sound in one tap.

scenes.title_en: The Final Ratio and the Result
scenes.context: 最后把监视器右下角比例改成9:16抖音格式，一个完整的AI数字人视频就做好了。播放最终效果：人生如棋局。
sentences: 在监视器右下角找到比例，把它改成9比16的抖音格式。
Find the ratio at the monitor's bottom-right and switch it to 9:16, the Douyin format.
the ratio（比例）
这样一来，一个完整的AI数字人视频就做好了。
And just like that, a complete AI digital-human video is done.
just like that（这样一来）
人生如棋局，不执着于一子之得失，方能收获更多。
Life is a game of chess — stop clinging to a single move's gain or loss, and you'll harvest more.
a single move（一子）
scenes.speak: Find the ratio at the monitor's bottom-right and switch it to 9:16, the Douyin format. And just like that, a complete AI digital-human video is done. Life is a game of chess — stop clinging to a single move's gain or loss, and you'll harvest more.

practice.a: The lip movement matches the voice.

pitfalls: Think a digital human must show your face.
Use built-in avatars or the green-screen theme.
No face needed — and green-screen lets you swap backgrounds freely.
Let smart-copy draft a few options, then pick one.
AI drafts beat a blank page.
Export with the scenery clip's original audio.
Detach the audio and delete it in one tap.

footer_notes: 原视频为剪映AI数字人制作教程口播（作者：自由摄影频道），转录为繁体已转简体，英文为场景意译，适合跟读学习视频制作表达；ASR 术语已按语境校正（简映→剪映、简介面→剪辑界面、订制→定制、超幌帧→超仿真、视听→试听、义子之得失→一子之得失、意識→一时、人声感悟→人生感悟、原生→原声、勾到→拖到）。
